summary: The stored rating cites only an open-label uncontrolled pilot (17109576). Controlled exercise trials are mostly null (11641371, 12660407, 12580655, 16521849, 16937963, 14660478), with dextrose ahead of ribose in rowers (16377979) and a benefit only in the less fit half of one crossover (29296106). A trial on soreness reports lower damage markers but a within-group soreness result (32778175). Cardiac results are positive in patients: a phase 2 HFpEF trial at 15 g/day (35644694), a CHF feasibility crossover of 15 (14607200), and 60 g/day for 3 days in coronary disease (1354276). Labels print 1.4 to 5.1 g a serving.
